name: Export DeepSearchQA from DataBazaar to CSV

parameters.content:
## DeepSearchQA → CSV
1. Inspect https://databazaar.io/d/4k and the original Google dataset card.
2. Create a DataBazaar account and API key at /operator/keys.
3. In Retrieve benchmark rows, create/select a Header Auth credential: Name = Authorization, Value = Bearer YOUR_KEY. Never put the key in this workflow JSON.
4. Execute manually. Download data from Create CSV file.

No purchases, uploads, model calls or scheduled triggers. At most 1,000 rows; stops if the listing is no longer free or the result differs from its declared row count.

Source: https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/deepsearchqa (Apache-2.0). Keep answers out of agent prompts; use the publisher evaluation protocol. This exports data, it does not score a model.
